firstPlayerRule: Each player rolls all six black dice and both green dice. Whoever rolls the most Attack symbols starts the game; turns then proceed clockwise.
clarifications: Use both green dice for this opening roll, even though ordinary turns use green dice only when a card allows it.
The rulebook does not say what to do if players tie for the most Attack symbols in the opening roll.
